text: The first generator you will build, and the one you will keep coming back to. The Drumheart stores up to **1,000 Pulse**, and every beat you give it adds more.

pages.title: Playing it
text: Right-click with an **empty hand**, about **once a second**. A beat on time gives **24 Pulse**. An off-beat gives at most **10**, and less the sooner it follows the last, so a steady pace beats fast clicking.

Machines draw from the drum through a [Lattice Conductor](lattice_conductor) within 8 blocks of it, never straight from it. To carry power somewhere else, use a **Pulse Cell** on the drum. Breaking the drum loses the Pulse it holds.
Playing by hand also wakes every totem within 8 blocks; see [Keeping](keeping).

steps.caption: A Drumheart on its own needs you to keep the beat.
Set a Heartbeat Plate beside it, ticking once a second.
Every pulse from the plate is a beat. The drum now fills itself while you work elsewhere.

pages.title: The rhythm, exactly
text: Redstone beats **17 to 23 game ticks** apart count as on time. Beats less than **8 ticks** apart are ignored. Twenty ticks is one second at normal server speed.
A held redstone signal does not pause the Drumheart; only the rising edge of a pulse counts as a beat.

Drums crowd each other out. Only **two drums in a zone** — the same 8-block reach a conductor weaves — make Pulse; any more still beat and still sound, but earn nothing. Spread them further apart than that and every one of them pays again.
Each [rank](machine_ranks) adds **15% Pulse a beat**. Generators do not speed up the way ranked stations do.
